data.content_ref: inline:The relation proposed is 'compatibility,' but the target's own refutation condition reveals the relation is vacuous: SRC_001's mechanism (emergent corrections) is said to be compatible with the Compliance Trap yet refuted if independence is compromised by shared bias mirroring the checklist. This means the 'compatibility' only holds when the two artifacts do not actually overlap in mechanism — when they DO overlap (shared bias), the relation is refuted. A substantive compatibility claim must specify how the mechanisms coexist without interference, but here the compatibility reduces to 'they are compatible unless they are not,' which is a tautology rather than a genuine relation. The refutation clause does not narrow the compatibility; it exposes that the proposed relation has no positive content.
